notes: Host-neutral planned activation/boundary coverage for v2 proof integrity, oracle strategies, nondeterminism, and concurrency histories. Scenarios remain planned until a harness executes them.

scenarios.prompt: Prove this API behavior with a focused integration test rather than asking the implementation agent if it works.
Design an oracle for this tenant authorization rule including a cross-tenant denied case.
Create a falsifiable test for idempotency under duplicate concurrent deliveries.
Fix the production code so the failing test passes.
Compare these two screenshots for spacing and alignment differences.
Check whether this implementation is correct, but no observable claim or candidate identity has been supplied.
The test runner is unavailable. Tell me whether the behavior is proven anyway.
The test fails, so update the expected output until it passes.
The implementation agent already ran its own tests. Treat that self-check as independent executable proof and promote the checkpoint.
The generated integration test crashed because its test container failed to start. Mark the product behavior as rejected.
We cannot know the exact output, but doubling every input should double the aggregate result. Design a metamorphic oracle.
Compare two independent implementations as a differential oracle, but do not assume the majority implementation is automatically correct.
The same candidate failed once and passed twice. Keep rerunning until green and report proven.
Verify that this proof receipt actually belongs to this frozen oracle spec and exact candidate rather than trusting its labels.
Prove this concurrent register is linearizable from the operation history, not just from the final value.
